label: In the explicit Bool-world/Nat-being parity model, every individual exists and is…, by Direct-proof
meaning: In the explicit Bool-world/Nat-being parity model, every individual exists and is de re necessary; there is an actual necessary being, actual reflexivity and no contingent ground of a necessary being. Each local support relation has no two-edge path and is well-founded. The necessary-support union is exactly g = n + 1: it has no nonempty finite cycle but is not well-founded. No individual is necessarily underived. This closed mathematical control does not establish metaphysical possibility or a root premise.
